fact: The Gambia's regulator PURA and Ghana's NCA signed an MoU in Banjul on 20 November 2024 to implement the ECOWAS roaming regulation, with a joint monitoring committee and a go-live date of 1 April 2025.
title: Memorandum of Understanding for the Implementation of the ECOWAS Regulation N°C/REG.21/12/17 on Roaming
publisher: National Communications Authority (Ghana) and Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (The Gambia)
